title: Annotation API NER entity
description: One named entity mention returned in `nes` by the /api/ner/ endpoint. Offsets are absolute in the submitted text. The keys are those of the previous TorchServe backend, frozen; the NER pipeline's own fields are served by the v2 entity routes. The server sends every key listed here, with null when there is no value.

type.description: Entity type. A coarse-grained Impresso-HIPE type (`pers`, `loc`, `org`, `time`, `prod`) for entities found by NER. It is an empty string when the type is unknown: in the NEL marker form, or when a /nel/ request entity has no type. /nel/ echoes the type sent by the client, so other values are possible.

surface.description: Surface form of the mention as it occurs in the submitted text.

lOffset.description: Zero-based offset of the first character of the mention in the submitted text (inclusive). Frozen wire name.

rOffset.description: Zero-based offset just after the last character of the mention in the submitted text (exclusive). Frozen wire name.

index.description: Word span of the mention in its sentence, as a [start, end) pair of word indices, or null.

confidence_ner.description: Overall NER confidence of the mention, or null when not available.

entity_confidence.description: Confidence that the span is an entity mention, independent of its type, or null when not computed. Named `confidence_ner_entity` in v2.

type_confidence.description: Confidence in the predicted type, given that the span is a mention, or null when not computed. Named `confidence_ner_type` in v2.

function.description: For a person mention, its `function` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null. The current NER model does not produce it, so it is always null.

name.description: For a person mention, its `name` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null. The current NER model does not produce it, so it is always null.

title.description: For a person mention, its `title` component (Impresso HIPE guidelines), otherwise null. The current NER model does not produce it, so it is always null.
